paite: Huaijiakin, ginna jiaka siamtansaka omin i Toupa Jesu Kris pansanin Pathian toh kilemin i om uhi.
english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

paite: Amah pansan mahin hiai hehpihna ah I lut ua; huaia dingin Pathian thupina i tan ding lametna ah kipakin i om uhi.
english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

paite: Huai kia leng hilou in, I gimthuakna ah leng kipakin I om uh, gimthuaknain kuhkalna a tuna,
english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering works perseverance;

paite: Kuhkalnain theihtelna a tuna, theihtelnain lametna a tun chih theiin;
english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:

paite: Huan, lametnain tuh honzahlaksak kei, huai Kha Siangthou i kiang ua honpiak pansana Pathian itna i lungtang ua suna a om tak jiakin.
english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

paite: I hat nai louhlaiin, a hun takin Kris tuh Pathian limsakloute sikin a hongsita ngala.
english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

paite: Mi dik sika sih, mi a ut ngel kei hial ding ua, mi hoih sikin bel mi kuahiam bekin sih a ngap khamoh kei ding.
english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.

paite: Himahleh, Pathianin a hon itna a langsakta mi khialte i hih laia Kris I sika a sihna ah.
english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

paite: Huchiin, a sisana siamtan saka i om khit nungin, amah jiakin Pathian hehna laka kipan hotdamin i om mahmah ngei ding hi.
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

paite: Melma i hih laia bawn a Tapa sihna jiaka Pathian toh nakitam khin i hih ngal un tuh, kitama i om khit nung un a hinna jiakin hotdamin i om sem ding hi.
english: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

paite: Huchi kia leng ahi keia, kitamna tua honmu sakpa i Toupa Jesu Kris jiakin Pathian ah leng i kipak ahi.
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

paite: Huchiin, mi khat jiakin khelhna khovelah a luta, khelhna jiakin sihna a luta, huchimahbangin mi tengtenga jelsuakta hi.
english: Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.

paite: Dan om ma in khovel ah khelhna a om khin ngala; dan a om louh laiin khelhna tuh khelhna a sim ahi kei hi.
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

paite: Himahleh, Adam oma kipan Mosi om phain Adam tatlekna banga thil hih khial loute tungah leng sihnain vai a hawm jel hi. Adam tuh hongpai ding tehpihna ahi.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

paite: Himahleh, thilthawnpiak jaw tatlekna toh a kibang kei. Mi khat tatlekna jiaka mi tampi a sih ua leh Pathian hehpihna leh mi khat Jesu Kris hehpihna thilthawnpiak tuh a kiching zosema mi tampi tunga vuhin a om.
english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

paite: Huan, thilthawnpiak tuh mi khat tatlekna gah toh leng a kibang sam kei. Mi khat tatlekna tunga vaihawmna in siamlouh tansakna a tuna, mi tampi tatlekna tunga thilthawnpiakin bel siam tansakna a tun hi.
english: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.

paite: Mi khat tatlekna jiaka sihnain huai mi khat mah pansana vai a hawm leh, hehpihna kiningching mahmah leh diktatna thawnpiak tangten mi khat Jesu Kris pansanin hinna a vai a hawm zosem ding uhi.
english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

paite: Huan, mi khat tatleknain mi tengteng adinga siamlouh tansakna a tut mah bangin, mi khat diktatna thilhih-in mi tengteng adingin suahtakna leh hinna a hontun hi.
english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

paite: Banghanghiam i chih leh, mi khat thumanlouhna jiaka mi tampi mikhiala bawl ahih bangun, mi khat thumanna jiakin mi tampi mi diktata bawl ahi ding uhi.
english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

paite: Khelhna latsak sem nadingin Dan a hongom behlapa; Ahihhangin khelhna a khanna peuh ah hehpihna a khang sem,Huchia, khelhnain sihnaa vai a hawm bangtaka, hehpihna inleng i Toupa Jesu Kris pansana diktatna jiaka khantawn hinna donga vai a hawm theihna dingin.
english: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;

paite: Huchia, khelhnain sihnaa vai a hawm bangtaka, hehpihna inleng i Toupa Jesu Kris pansana diktatna jiaka khantawn hinna donga vai a hawm theihna dingin.
english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
